correctness.rationale: The 32-vertex object and all face predicates are explicit. Complete enumeration gives 254,475 faces including empty; the acyclic 127,231-pair Morse matching leaves critical degrees 0,5,7 of counts 1,1,10. A full 1,844,864-incidence DAG check proves acyclicity. Zero adjacent critical dimensions show integral H5=Z,H7=Z^10 and no torsion. Each of the ten induced eight-edge matching spheres is a signed cycle, the exact Morse projection determinant is -1 and hence the cycles form a primitive integral basis. All 3840 cube automorphisms pass exact orientation and Lefschetz traces; generator characters prove H5 is determinant. Computational checker and its output are embedded.

value.rationale: The exact same five-cube theta example had unresolved integral homology in the primary Conant–Thistlethwaite work. An explicit unimodular geometric sphere lattice, a proof of torsion-freeness and the complete 3840-element integral symmetry action answer this motivated open integrality/equivariance gap. The facts are not consequences of the known rational Betti table; they inform integral and equivariant topology of this canonical symmetric graph. No broader theorem or wedge homotopy is asserted.
